subject: Request: commit attribution + secrets rotation history for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Amy Lucas <amy.lucas@northbridge-assessors.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 intake: commit attribution + secrets rotation history

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC2 scoping for Greenline Financial we need a concise package that shows (a) commit attribution for the last 90 days for production-affecting repos, and (b) secrets/keystore rotation records tied to deploys during that period. The assessor will want: commit hashes + author emails, PR/merge timestamps, which CI run produced the artifact, and evidence that ephemeral credentials were used where appropriate.

Could you please provide:
- A machine-readable commit attribution export (CSV preferred).
- CI execution logs (redacted tokens OK) showing which job produced each release artifact.
- Keystore/secret rotation CSV with rotation timestamps and steward names.
- A short narrative (2-3 bullets) describing our merge gate + PR review enforcement.

Deadline: EOB Monday (2026-12-06). If anything is sensitive, we can accept redacted extracts and an in-person walkthrough.

Appreciate it — amy

--
Amy Lucas
Senior Assessor, Northbridge Assessors
amy.lucas@northbridge-assessors.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Lucas <amy.lucas@northbridge-assessors.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: commit attribution + secrets rotation history

Amy — thanks for the clear ask. We'll assemble a compact package and aim to deliver a redacted bundle by Monday EOB. Plan and owners below: 

- Commit attribution CSV: Jordan will produce the csv (repo list limited to infra/, runtime/, api/) with hash, author email, PR id, merge timestamp. (owner: Jordan)
- CI execution logs: I'll pull the pipeline artefacts and redact runner tokens; we will include job ids and artifact checksums. (owner: Mina)
- Keystore rotation: Karthik will extract rotation events from the KeyOps ledger and correlate to deploys. We'll include steward and rotation ticket id. (owner: Karthik)
- Narrative: Irene will draft the PR/merge gate description and link to the repo branch protection rules. (owner: Irene)

Attachments we will include in the first drop: commit-attribution.csv (csv), ci-execution-log-20261122.tar.gz (log archive), keystore-rotation-audit.csv (csv), sdlc-artifact-manifest.pdf (2-page summary). If you need a verifier-friendly index, we will also attach a one-line manifest that maps artifacts to HubSpot intake HS-45672.

Two quick clarifying questions: 
1) For commit attribution, do you prefer author email or team alias only? We can provide both; emails are more useful for auditor matching.
2) The assessor mentioned ephemeral credentials evidence — do you want the raw runner metadata or just the statement that ephemeral tokens (short-lived vault leases) are used along with sample lease IDs?

I'll kick off the exports and loop back with the first package by Monday morning so you have time to review before EOB.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Lucas <amy.lucas@northbridge-assessors.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 15:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: commit attribution + secrets rotation history

Mina / Amy — attaching the commit attribution export per Mina's plan. Attestation: the CSV was produced by running our internal git-attribution tool across the three repos identified; hashes, author emails, PR numbers and merge timestamps are included. The CSV has been scoped to production-affecting branches only (main, release/*).

[Attachment: commit-attribution.csv (CSV) — 12,094 rows; headers: repo,commit_hash,author_email,pr_id,merge_timestamp] 

I've also added a short index in the manifest mapping commit ranges to CI artifact checksums. We'll hand the CI log archive and keystore rotation CSV in the next message (Mina / Karthik working those).

— Jordan

On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 11:05 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Amy — thanks for the clear ask. We'll assemble a compact package and aim to deliver a redacted bundle by Monday EOB.
> 
> - Commit attribution CSV: Jordan will produce the csv ...

--
Jordan Blake
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform Security
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
From: Amy Lucas <amy.lucas@northbridge-assessors.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 14:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: commit attribution + secrets rotation history

Thanks Jordan and Mina — received the CSV and the manifest index. A couple quick follow-ups before we close the intake: 

- For the keystore rotation CSV, can you ensure the steward column includes Red ID (e.g., redwood:username) rather than only display names? Our mapping scripts expect stable IDs.
- Please include the migration ticket or PR id that triggered any out-of-band rotation so we can see the exception handling.

If you can send those two items by COB Monday 2026-12-07 we'll be set for the assessor review on Tuesday. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call Monday morning to walk through the artifacts — let me know availability.

Best — Amy

--
Amy Lucas
Senior Assessor, Northbridge Assessors
amy.lucas@northbridge-assessors.com
